rationale: The assistant matched the ground truth closely: it put airflow and programme selection first with the dryer unplugged, correctly identified the thermal cut-out versus element ambiguity after the clogged hose was found, and refused to name a part without a continuity test and full model number ('Avoid fitting a heater element or cut-out based only on the symptoms'). Escalation to an engineer once the customer said they had no multimeter is exactly the expected path, and it added the useful point that the vent run must stay clear or a replacement cut-out will fail again. Minor gaps: it never asked for or explained how to find the full model number for the engineer, and did not probe the history of slow drying, but nothing was fabricated or unsafe.
